description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402] Rounds, adds, subtracts, multiplies, or splits an amount of an ISO 4217 currency, using that currency's real number of minor units (JPY 0, USD 2, KWD 3). A currency not in the list is refused, never assumed to have 2 decimals. split divides a total into equal parts or by ratios so the parts always add back to the total exactly.

rounding.description: rounding rule; default half_up (ties away from zero). half_even is banker's rounding
